notes: GST 10% (GST Act 2003 s.8). Bullion EXEMPT: s.25(3) exempts supplies of fine metal (gold >=99.5% fine; silver >=99.9%); s.21(1)(b) zero-rates a refiner's first supply of new fine metal. Jewellery is not fine metal (10%). Silver bullion exempt, jewellery 10%. Duty 0%: all HS 7108 lines Free (Customs Tariff Act Sch. 1, HS 2022).

sources.name: Goods and Services Tax Act 2003 (consolidated Act, PNG Office of Legislative Counsel / PacLII), ss.8 and 25(3)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: GST is charged at 10% on supplies other than exempt supplies, and the supply of fine metal is exempt from tax
sources.quote: The supply of fine metal, not being a supply which, but for this subsection, would be charged with tax at the rate of zero percent under Section 19 or 21 is exempt from tax under this Act.

sources.name: PNG Customs Service (customs.gov.pg) - Customs Tariff Act 1990, Schedule 1 (HS 2022)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: HS 7108 lines (powder, unwrought, semi-manufactured, monetary) are all Free
